entities.name: Karl Hård af Segerstad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karl Hård af Segerstad was a Finnish architect. He came from a Swedish family, but lived and worked his whole life in Finland, mainly in Helsinki and Viipuri. He was appointed city architect of Helsinki in 1907. One of his most famous works is the Nylands Nation building (1899–1901) at the University of Helsinki in Helsinki.
